newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says futures trade to re-open at 0735 CST.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says futures trade to re-open at 0735 CST.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said financial futures trade will reopen at 0735 CST/1435 GMT after phone problems delayed the start of trading.
It was the second consecutive day where technical problems halted trading on the exchange's new trading floor.

An exchange official said it was too early to tell if Thursday's problem with the CBOT's trading floor telephone system was related to Wednesday's glitch with the CBOT's price reporting system software.
Trade was halted for 40 minutes on Wednesday.
